# gh reference

## gh pr <command>

Manage pull requests

### gh pr create [flags]

Create a pull request

### gh pr merge [<number> | <url> | <branch>] [flags]

Merge a pull request

## gh issue <command>

Manage issues

### gh issue create [flags]

Create a new issue

## gh widget <command>

Manage widgets (synthetic)

### gh widget make [flags]

Make a new widget
